seo.title: Steps AI vs Manychat: an honest comparison | Steps AI
seo.description: Compare Steps AI and Manychat: channels, order lookups, pricing model and where each one is the better fit.

hero.title: Steps AI vs Manychat: flows or an agent that answers.
hero.body: Manychat is known for building automated flows on Instagram, WhatsApp and Messenger. Steps AI answers the questions customers actually ask, in their own words, and checks your store before it replies.
hero.reassurance: Where we fit. Where they fit. How to switch.

glance.title: At a glance.
glance.intro: How Steps AI and Manychat compare on the questions owners ask most.

rows.label: What it is
rows.steps: An AI agent that answers customers and checks real records before it replies
rows.them: A flow builder for automated conversations and marketing on social channels

rows.label: Channels
rows.steps: Website, WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger from one Meta connection, plus phone calls

rows.label: Order and delivery questions
rows.steps: Checks orders in Shopify or WooCommerce and shipments with five Indian carriers
rows.them: Built into flows you design and maintain

rows.label: How you pay
rows.steps: Per reply in credits. The cost of a reply depends on the AI model you choose
rows.them: Plans are priced by the number of contacts

rows.label: What happens after the answer
rows.steps: Books appointments, creates tickets, saves leads and hands over to a person
rows.them: Follows the paths you build in each flow

ours.title: When Steps AI is the better fit.
ours.intro: Choose Steps AI if these sound like you.

items.title: Customers go off-script
items.body: Flows follow buttons and keywords. Steps AI understands a question written any way and answers from your information.

items.title: You want order answers, not menus
items.body: The agent checks the order in your store instead of sending the customer down a menu.

items.title: You do not want to pay per contact
items.body: Steps AI plans are based on credits used by replies, not on the size of your contact list.

theirs.title: When Manychat may suit you better.
theirs.intro: We would rather you pick the right tool than the wrong one.

items.title: You run detailed Instagram growth campaigns
items.body: Manychat has a long track record with creators and marketers building complex social flows.

items.title: You want every step scripted
items.body: If you prefer to control each message in a fixed flow, a flow builder suits that way of working.

switching.title: Moving from Manychat to Steps AI.
switching.intro: Most businesses are answering real customers within a day.

items.title: Paste your website address
items.body: Steps AI reads your pages, FAQs and documents, so you do not have to rebuild your answers by hand.

items.title: Connect your channels and store
items.body: One Meta connection covers WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger. Add Shopify or WooCommerce for order questions.

items.title: Test it against your own questions
items.body: Ask the questions your customers ask. Switch it on when you are happy with the answers.

goodToKnow.title: Good to know
items: This comparison uses publicly available information about Manychat as of October 2026. Check their site for current plans and features.
Steps AI does not answer inbound email, and AI voice calls are billed as credits.

faq.title: Questions about Steps AI and Manychat.

items.q: Can I try Steps AI before I switch?
items.a: Yes. You can start free with no card, test the agent against your own questions and switch when you are ready.
You pay per reply in credits. The number of credits a reply uses depends on the AI model you choose for your agent.

items.q: Can I run Steps AI alongside Manychat?
items.a: Yes, many businesses test both before deciding. Make sure only one tool replies on each channel at a time.
